config.analysis: Confirmation-only paired seed-block percentile interval over 40 whole seeds, equal scenario weighting. Report original final separately; no significance pooling.
config.budget: Same original retained 7200-second build budget; no reset. Truncation is failure, not a smaller claimed successful study.
config.decision_rule: Strict positive confirmation lower interval, no confirmation family mean regression, coverage loss at most 0.05, exact-source model and all episodes valid, OOF model check and real exact-mode container. Original failed gate remains reported.
config.reason: The original final point advantage has a descriptive paired interval including zero. Obtain an independent larger confirmation without refitting or policy selection.
